name: Pasrur
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Urdu first-party discovery identified the local Pasrur Revenue Department/Arazi Record Center and the PLRA service network. The official Ask for Taqseem viewer and public OpenAPI configuration were inspected. Administrative lookup requests reached Sialkot district, Pasrur tehsil, and the Pasrur mauza, but advertised geometry routes returned HTML and the bounded mauza khewat request returned HTTP 500. No safe native parcel ID plus geometry was obtained.
